title: Owner: first pub.dev release of `codeality_lints` then `codeality_dart` is
blocker: manual (pub.dev cannot enable automated publishing for a package that does not exist). Blocked on the owner's pub.dev login. Smallest step: in each of `packages/codeality-dart-lints` and `packages/codeality-dart` run `dart pub publish`, then on each package's Admin tab enable GitHub Actions publishing (repository `syntopica/codeality`, tag pattern `<name>-v{{version}}`, environment `pub.dev`); CLAUDE.md has the steps. Until then consumers (stagebeat) pin both by git ref.
